name: Jax
_comment_about_offsets: rot_offset_euler_deg is added AFTER the SMPL axis-angle is converted to a Blender quaternion. Use it to absorb mismatches between SMPL's joint frame and the Rigify bone's roll. Common values are 0 / +/- 90 / +/- 180. Edit these during Phase F calibration when you see a bone rotated wrong on a real take.
_comment_about_root: Options: 'ignore' (best for Path A monocular — drift-prone; keyframe walk path by hand), 'follow' (use SMPL trans as-is), 'follow_xy' (XY only, hold Z at rest — useful for sit/stand transitions).

axis_conversion._comment: Whole-armature rotation applied to the rig OBJECT before per-bone rotations. JaxRigify is already built standing upright in Blender's Z-up world, so the rest pose (all-zero SMPL rotations) should land on Jax's existing T-pose — no whole-body rotation needed. SMPL/Blender axis differences are handled per-bone via rot_offset_euler_deg above. Keep this at [0, 0, 0] unless a future character needs the whole rig flipped (e.g. an asset imported from a Y-up DCC). If a real take comes in lying on its face, fix the per-bone offsets, NOT this value.
